name: Royce White
summary:
Royce Alexander White (born April 10, 1991) is an American political candidate and former professional basketball player who was the Republican Party's nominee in the 2024 United States Senate election in Minnesota and is a Republican candidate for the 2028 presidential election.
A two-time Minnesota State High School League (MSHSL) champion, White was named a Class 3A MSHSL champion in 2006 as a freshman at DeLaSalle High School; as a senior, he was named Minnesota Mr. Basketball and won a H Class 4A MSHSL championship with Hopkins High School in 2009, leading Hopkins to a perfect (31–0) record.
